steps.name: Epilogue ~ Invitation
steps.objective: Check out the story of [Chloris] and [Zephyros] in front of the “Twilight Cathedral” where Adventurer left.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Jeffy, you've had a hard time. Without even knowing it, I... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, don't cry. Pop.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … huh. Pop.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Like this?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Don't be too pretentious.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Okay. So shall we go now? uh… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Wait… .
(Chloris raises her head and looks at the spire at the top of the Twilight Cathedral.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, you felt something, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There was someone up there. The witch is gone, but who... . Wait a minute, this is the kind of magic I felt somewhere. Really, the Magic Agency?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, shush.
(As Zephyrus looks around warily, Chloris quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ah, yes. Hey Jeffy… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Why, Chloe?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I remembered a place I need to go before I go back to school. Would you like to go with me? no. I'll just go alone. uh… .
(Chloris is slightly surprised by Zephyrus' action of holding her hand.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let's go together.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ugh, yeah… . okay.
(Zephyros and Chloris finish their story and take their steps toward the Crystal Moon Forest.)
(After a while, the boy who was hiding behind the cathedral's spire walks out, his ears perking up.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: That wizard, it’s been a while. By the way, is the witch over?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I came this far and couldn't find the witch. Oh, I'm so annoyed... . For some reason, it seemed like another witch was going to attack the player.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Let's go, Lycaria.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Huh? Lyricaria?
(Noname calls out the name of Madogolem Lycaria, but there is no response.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I was this close, but I couldn't believe you noticed. who is this? Who has my Lyricaria... .
(Noname spots a man holding Lycaria and adjusting his glasses.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Archduke… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's been a while. Boy with no name. It's nice to see this golem after a long time.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: That's unexpected, Grand Duke. It appears all the way here.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Are you asking this knowingly? The Archduke knew how I was doing.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I'm simply asking how you are.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Okay, let's say hello. You see, I haven't been doing well.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: If only I hadn’t met the unsophisticated Adventurer and the little boy at the Orcarium… . You must have held that power in your hands. And that he would never have died and come back to life.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Boy with no name. What did you say just now? Could you say that again?
(As Barbatos is surprised, Lycaria is released from control and goes to Noname's side again.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Didn't you hear? He died and came back to life. So I came to catch the witch, but it was in vain.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I see. It was something like that.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hahaha, hahaha, hahahahaha.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What is it, Archduke?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You seeped into this world so slowly that I couldn't even feel the shadow it cast on this world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You also saved this boy.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Were you watching this place from the black moon after all? .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Grand Duke, why are you talking to yourself? Who are you talking to?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He was the one who needed the boy and took him out between life and death. Similar to me, yet different... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's a place I'll have to visit someday, but it's a bit early. It would have been better if I had gone after throwing away the shell of a demon.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Boy.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Why, Archduke?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Your plan has already gone awry. How about following me?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Hey, that's him. What changes when you meet him?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: No matter who you are, your fate will change.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Maybe there's something for you to do there. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Do you really have to go now?
(Barvatos looks interested in Noname’s question.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Shall we decide by tossing a silver coin? Now, take a look. The side with the devil's horns on it is the front.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If you come in front, follow me... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What if the back comes out?
(Barvatos throws a coin into the air with a sneer.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Let's assume that we will not go to ▒▒▒▒ where the light has disappeared... .
(A moment later, shiny silver coins flow into Barbatos' hands.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What you owe me, I will accept by dying right here.
